summary: New sense 1b: einander angreifen, Schläge wechseln (mit b-ḥḏoḏe; b-: Waffe)

data.label: 1b
data.gloss: einander angreifen, Schläge wechseln (mit b-ḥḏoḏe; b-: Waffe)

rationale: Reciprocal b ḥḏoḏe plus swords describes mutual combat followed by an actual sword blow; this specializes directed transfer rather than simple hand-to-hand passing. One clear attestation.

data.turoyo: <...> Qayəm, mnawalle b ḥḏoḏe bas sayfe. <...>
data.translation: <...> Der Riese erhob sich und sie griffen einander mit den Schwertern an. <...>

rationale: First example of the new reciprocal combat construction; complete coordinated sentence.

summary: The reciprocal participant relation and the weapon both use b-, but have different roles: b ḥḏoḏe identifies opponents and bas sayfe the means of attack.
Plural Preterit mnawalle is retained under II. It introduces mutual combat, with the following feminine sword-blow clause confirming a violent exchange.
A construction subsense preserves inherited label 1 and its pencil example. No second idiom listing or unrelated general sense 'fight' is added.
Confirm whether nwl b-ḥḏoḏe can mean mutual attack without a weapon phrase, or specifically the exchange of blows.
Does the relation to ordinary passing remain transparent to speakers? Only this one combat context is supplied.
